description: KPI baseline for P2P identity and crypto layer (Phase 5 §5.2)

ed25519_keygen_p99_ms.description: P99 Ed25519 key-pair generation time (must be < 20 ms)

ed25519_sign_p99_us.description: P99 Ed25519 sign() latency (must be < 2 ms)

ed25519_verify_p99_us.description: P99 Ed25519 verify() latency (must be < 2 ms)

hkdf_derive_p99_us.description: P99 HKDF key derivation (must be < 1 ms)

identity_test_suite_total_ms.description: Total wall-clock time for all identity tests (must be < 4 s)

thresholds.description: Any metric worse than baseline by >5% is a KPI regression requiring revert
